SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm AS average_lead_time, (pv.stnd_prc - pv.lst_rcpt_cst) AS net_profit, CONCAT_WS(', ', a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, sp.nm, c.nm, a.pstl_cd) AS full_location FROM prod_vnd pv JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref3 = v.ref1 JOIN biz_addr ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1 JOIN addr a ON ba.ref2 = a.addr_id LEFT JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id LEFT JOIN cnty c ON sp.ref2 = c.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE pv.ref2 = 843

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm AS average_lead_time, (p.lst_prc - p.stnd_cst) AS net_profit, CONCAT_WS(', ', a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, sp.nm, a.pstl_cd, c.nm) AS vendor_full_location FROM prod_vnd pv JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref3 JOIN vnd v ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2 JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = v.ref1 JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref3 LEFT JOIN st_prv sp ON sp.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1 LEFT JOIN cnty c ON c.cntr_rgn_cd = sp.ref2 WHERE pv.ref3 = 843

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm AS average_lead_time, (p.lst_prc - p.stnd_cst) AS net_profit, CONCAT_WS(', ', a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, sp.nm, a.pstl_cd, c.nm) AS vendor_full_location FROM prod p JOIN prod_vnd pv ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id JOIN vnd v ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2 JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = v.ref1 JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref3 JOIN st_prv sp ON sp.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1 JOIN cnty c ON c.cntr_rgn_cd = sp.ref2 WHERE p.prdc_id = 843

SELECT d.nm AS department, AVG(ph.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM dept d
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN emp_pay_hist ph ON ph.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) latest ON latest.ref1 = ph.ref1 AND latest.max_dt = ph.rt_chng_dt
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

SELECT d.dprt_id, d.nm, AVG(eph.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM emp_pay_hist eph
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_rt_chng_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) latest ON latest.ref1 = eph.ref1 AND latest.max_rt_chng_dt = eph.rt_chng_dt
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = eph.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

SELECT d.dprt_id, d.nm, AVG(latest_pay.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM (
    SELECT ref1, rt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC, mdfd_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
) latest_pay
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = latest_pay.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE latest_pay.rn = 1
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH RECURSIVE BOM_cte AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS ProductAssemblyID, b.ref2 AS ComponentID, b.pr_assm_qty AS PerAssemblyQty, b.bm_lvl AS BOMLevel
  FROM bom b
  WHERE b.ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref3, b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty, b.bm_lvl
  FROM bom b
  INNER JOIN BOM_cte cte ON b.ref3 = cte.ComponentID
)
SELECT cte.ComponentID, p.nm AS Name, cte.BOMLevel, cte.PerAssemblyQty
FROM BOM_cte cte
JOIN prod p ON cte.ComponentID = p.prdc_id
ORDER BY cte.BOMLevel

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree (prdc_id, lvl) AS (
  SELECT prdc_id, 0
  FROM prod
  WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.prdc_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT p.nm AS component, bt.lvl AS level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.prdc_id
WHERE bt.lvl > 0
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
      AND b.end_dt IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, bt.lvl + 1
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
    WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm AS component_name, bt.lvl
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  WHERE b.ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2
  FROM bom b
  INNER JOIN bom_cte c ON b.ref3 = c.component_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom_cte

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.pr_assm_qty AS qty
    FROM prod p
    JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
      AND b.end_dt IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, bt.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
    WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_components
FROM bom_tree

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.pr_assm_qty AS qty
  FROM prod p
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58' AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(qty) FROM bom_tree
SELECT MAX(bm_lvl) FROM bom WHERE ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT b.bll_of_mtrl_id, b.ref2, b.ref3, b.bm_lvl
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.bll_of_mtrl_id, b.ref2, b.ref3, b.bm_lvl
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.ref2
)
SELECT MAX(bm_lvl) AS deepest_assembly_level
FROM bom_tree

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (
    SELECT b.ref3 AS assembly_id, b.ref2 AS component_id, b.bm_lvl
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref3, b.ref2, b.bm_lvl
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_cte c ON b.ref3 = c.component_id
)
SELECT MAX(bm_lvl) AS deepest_assembly_level
FROM bom_cte

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.pr_assm_qty AS total_qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty * c.total_qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_cte c ON b.ref3 = c.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(p.stnd_cst * c.total_qty) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_cte c
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = c.component_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte (component_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
      AND b.end_dt IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty * bc.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_cte bc ON b.ref3 = bc.component_id
    WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(bc.qty * p.stnd_cst) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_cte bc
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bc.component_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.pr_assm_qty AS qty
    FROM bom b
    WHERE b.ref3 = (
        SELECT prdc_id
        FROM prod
        WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, bom_cte.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_cte ON b.ref3 = bom_cte.component_id
    WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(bom_cte.qty * p.stnd_cst) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_cte
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bom_cte.component_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod c ON b.ref2 = c.prdc_id
    WHERE c.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref2 = bt.prdc_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.prdc_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_products AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS product_id
  FROM bom b
  WHERE b.ref2 IN (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'Adjustable Race')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref3
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_products bp ON b.ref2 = bp.product_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM bom_products bp
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bp.product_id
ORDER BY p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE usage AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON b.ref2 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT b.ref3
  FROM bom b
  JOIN usage u ON b.ref2 = u.prdc_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM usage u
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = u.prdc_id

SELECT p.nm FROM prod p WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM so_dtl sd WHERE sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id)

SELECT CONCAT(p.frst_nm, ' ', p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL AND e.crrn_flg = 1
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm) AS full_name, emp.jb_ttl
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3
JOIN dept ON emp_dept_hist.ref2 = dept.dprt_id
WHERE dept.nm = 'Sales'
  AND emp_dept_hist.end_dt IS NULL
  AND emp.crrn_flg = 1
ORDER BY prsn.lst_nm
SELECT stor.nm, addr.cty, st_prv.nm FROM stor JOIN biz_addr ON stor.ref2 = biz_addr.ref1 JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref2 = addr.addr_id JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id ORDER BY stor.nm

SELECT s.nm AS store_name, a.cty AS city, sp.nm AS state_province
FROM stor s
JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = s.ref2
JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref3
JOIN st_prv sp ON sp.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1
ORDER BY s.nm

SELECT s.nm, a.cty, sp.nm
FROM stor s
JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = s.ref2
JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref3
JOIN st_prv sp ON sp.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1
ORDER BY s.nm

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist h ON h.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE h.rt > 50
  AND h.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(h2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist h2
    WHERE h2.ref1 = h.ref1
  )

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON e.ref1 = eph.ref1
WHERE eph.rt > 50
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
    WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE eph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
    WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
)
AND eph.rt > 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
      SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
      FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
      WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )
  AND eph.rt > 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN (
  SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS latest_rt_chng_dt
  FROM emp_pay_hist
  GROUP BY ref1
) latest ON latest.ref1 = eph.ref1 AND latest.latest_rt_chng_dt = eph.rt_chng_dt
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND eph.rt > 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1) AS employee_count
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND eph.rt > 20
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
      SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
      FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
      WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl)
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref2 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref1 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes'
AND YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref1 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes' AND YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT SUM(so_dtl.ln_ttl)
FROM so_dtl
JOIN so_hdr ON so_dtl.ref3 = so_hdr.sls_ordr_id
JOIN spcl_prod ON so_dtl.ref1 = spcl_prod.ref2 AND so_dtl.ref2 = spcl_prod.ref1
JOIN prod ON spcl_prod.ref1 = prod.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ON prod.ref2 = prod_sub.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat ON prod_sub.ref1 = prod_cat.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE prod_cat.nm = 'Bikes' AND YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013
